scenarios.preReviewBody:
Hi Rachel,

We spoke in March about consumer coverage at Morrow & Pike, and I have a short update to share.

This summer I interned at Pinecrest Wealth Partners, where I built a screening model for 40 dividend stocks that was used in client portfolio reviews. I'm also a consumer sector analyst in the Duke Investment Club, so the coverage we talked about is still on my mind.

I saw on LinkedIn that you were promoted to director. Congratulations!

If you ever have 10 minutes to catch up, I'd enjoy it, and I completely understand if things are busy. Thank you again for the time you gave me in March.

Best,
